# M8: Schema version 2 and the 12 sharp/flat cards (data model first)

Goal: saved progress moves to schema version 2 with **no loss**, and the domain knows the 12
sign cards and the part-2 curriculum types. **No screen changes** (the live app looks the same;
no part-2 lesson exists yet). Spec: SPEC §8.1, §8.2, §8.8 (types only); `SCHEMA-V2.md` (all of it).

This is the riskiest milestone for the learner's progress. Read `SCHEMA-V2.md` §2 before starting.

## Steps
1. **Notes and pitches** (`notes.ts`): `Sign`, `Pitch`, `pitchMidi`, `pitchName` (§8.1) with tests
   (every one of the 12 sign cards and a sample of naturals; `pitchName` never contains a digit).
2. **Cards** (`cards.ts`): `NATURAL_CARDS` (today's 34, same order), `SIGN_CARDS` (12), `ALL_CARDS`
   (46), `parseCardId` → `{ clef, note, sign }`, `cardMidi`. Update every caller (part-1 behaviour
   must not change: run the whole unit suite after this step before going on). Add the self-check
   from §8.1 (part-1 pools and kinds only use `NATURAL_CARDS`).
3. **Schema v2** exactly as `SCHEMA-V2.md` §3 items 2–5 (progress, upgrade step, validate, backup).
   One commit: "Schema v2: allow sharp and flat cards".
4. **ids lock**: add the 12 card ids to `ids.lock.json` (same commit as step 2 or 3).
5. **Fixture**: write `tests/fixtures/progress-v2.json` as `SCHEMA-V2.md` §4; record its hash in
   `fixtures.lock.json`. Do **not** touch `progress-v1.json`.
6. **Tests**: every test in `SCHEMA-V2.md` §5 (items 1–11). Each is a separate, named test so a
   reviewer can find it. Existing tests that hard-code `schemaVersion: 1` for **new** documents
   change to 2; tests that load the v1 fixture stay and must still pass.
7. **Curriculum types** (no data yet): `LessonMaterial`, `render: 'rhythm'`, `unit` 1..25,
   `CheckpointDef` ids `cp-a`…`cp-f` with optional `mix`/`material` (§8.8). No new lessons,
   no new checkpoints in the data. Existing curriculum tests stay green.
8. **Mutation checks** from `SCHEMA-V2.md` §6: run each, record results in `NOTES.md`.
9. Update `SPEC.md` §4.6/§4.7/§4.8 text to say version 2 where the code now does (remove the
   "// 2 from M8" notes), `docs/HANDOFF.md` (state, next step) and `NOTES.md`.
10. `npm run verify` green; "debug again" pass (STANDARDS §5; the visual QA step is only a
    check that nothing changed). Open the PR.

## Review step (Opus)
Use the review prompt in `docs/build/README.md` with M8, **and** run `/security-review` (this
touches untrusted-data handling). The reviewer must: load `progress-v1.json` through the real
store in a test and diff every field; confirm no existing upgrade step or fixture was edited;
confirm an older-app simulation refuses v2 data without writing.

## Acceptance
- Old saves (v1 fixture, real phone data shape) load with every field intact and are written back
  as v2 on the next save; older app versions refuse v2 data instead of dropping cards.
- No visible change in the app. `npm run verify` green.
